addr: 6th Main Rd, Ibblur, Green Glen Layout, Bellandur, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560102, India

rev.t: This place is a good addition to the locality, and was a much needed store for the residents. They have a wide range of products which should suffice most of the needs of the restaurant. In the basement, they also have a vegetable shop. It seems that they are planning to add a fish market as well in the basement.

Hypermarket stocking everything required for managing the day to day consumables of a household from fresh vegetables, groceries, frozen items, dairy products, to kitchen items, crockery, utensils, to soaps and lotions, cleaning items, to baby products, pet food, stationery, luggage etc.
Huge variety of stuff, from groceries to stationery. Staff is helpful. Always crowded due to big settlements nearby.
